name: Captain of the Buckled Mind
body:
Price 10,000 gp; Aura moderate abjuration, conjuration, and transmutation; CL 10th; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This tall, wide-brimmed hat is encircled with a leather band that is fastened with a brass buckle. The capotain functions as both a headband of unshakable resolveue and a cap of the free thinkerue.

If worn by an legendary inquisitor for more than 1 hour, it grants her 3 additional rounds per day of her bane ability.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 20,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells bane, mind blank, owl’s wisdom, remove fear
